headline: Trump turns to Asia. "We want magnets"
summary: US President Donald Trump called on Southeast Asian countries to increase supplies of critical minerals and magnets to reduce US dependence on China, ahead of planned talks with Xi Jinping.
why: Rare earth magnets and critical minerals are essential inputs for electric vehicles, defense equipment and electronics, and China dominates their supply chains.
original_headline: Trump zwrócił się do Azji. "Chcemy magnesów"
